title: Mutisi wa Xiluvelo hi ku hatlisa
intro: Ehubyeni ya mufumi wa matimba, ku endliwe xilaveko lexi nga kotekiki, naswona vo tala va phikizane ku kombisa nkoka wa vona. Hambi swi ri tano, ntirho lowu a wu ta hetisisiwa ntsena hi loyi ku hlangana ka yena ni vutivi bya Xikwembu ku tlulaka vutshila hinkwabyo bya nyama, ku paluxa nkarhi lowu a wu ta twala hi malembe.
clues: A ndzi ri entirhweni wa hosi leyikulu leyi na yona a yi ri muprofeta, naswona a ndzi yime exikarhi ka xirhendzevutana xa yona lexi a xi tshemba ngopfu.
A ndzi nga ri xivumbiwa xa ndzilo kumbe xivumbiwa lexi nga ni matimba lamakulu ya miri, kambe a ndzi khome nchumu wun’wana lowu nga ni matimba swinene.
Loko hosi yi kombela leswaku ku tisiwa xiluvelo lexi humaka etikweni ra le kule, a ndzi swi tiva kahle leswi ndzi faneleke ndzi swi endla.
Ndzi vulavule hi vutivi lebyi a ndzi ri na byona ku suka eBuku, naswona ku nga si angula munhu, xiluvelo xi vekiwile emahlweni ka hosi.
Xiendlo xa mina a xi nga ri hi matimba ya mina, kambe a ku ri ku kombisa leswaku vutivi bya ntiyiso byi huma eka Allah ntsena.
Hi mina loyi a tiseke xiluvelo xa Hosi ya Xisati ya Xeba hi ku tsindziyela ka tihlo, hilaha swi tsariweke hakona eka Surah An-Naml.

identity.label: Xana Ndzi mani?
options: Loyi a a ri na vutivi bya Buku
Jinn ya matimba Ifrit
Xinyenyana xa hoopoe xa le Sulayman
Muprofeta Sulayman
Hosi ya xisati ya le Xeba
identity.answer: Loyi a a ri na vutivi bya Buku

arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِى عِندَهُۥ عِلْمٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّى لِيَبْلُوَنِىٓ ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ ۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّى غَنِىٌّۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
verse: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous." (27:40)
